Chateau Dif Pondy

A self-check-in house between Pondy Rock Beach and Auroville.

Watch the video tour

Please read before booking

We want your stay to have no surprises. These are the four things guests most need to know.

  • Self-check-in, self-service stayThere is no caretaker. The whole house opens with number locks, and you look after the house during your stay. Check-in and check-out times are flexible.
  • No air conditioningThe house has ventilated Italian tiles, so AC isn’t possible. Ceiling fans and tower fans keep it comfortable.
  • Dust on windy nightsA little dust may enter through small gaps in the roof. We keep this to a minimum and protect the beds with dust covers.
  • Smoking outdoors onlyDrinks are welcome anywhere in the house, but smoking is restricted to the outdoors.
  • Flexible check-in and check-outThere are no fixed times, so plan your travel comfortably.
  • 15 km from Pondy Rock Beach, 10 km from Auroville JunctionThe house is not walking distance from either.
  • Sleeps 4, up to 6 at no extra charge1 queen bed, 1 single and 1 foldable single upstairs. A 5th and 6th guest use the two hall sofa beds, at no additional charge.

How the house runs

  • Number locks on the whole house, no keys to carry
  • No caretaker, fully self-service
  • Lights and water motor run automatically
  • Inverter backup for power cuts
  • Geyser for hot water
  • Smart TV with internet
  • Swiggy delivers here
  • Drinks welcome anywhere in the house

Who sleeps where

  • Bedroom1 queen bed2
  • Upstairs1 single bed and 1 foldable single bed2
  • Hall2 sofa beds, for a 5th and 6th guest+2

The two hall sofa beds are at no additional charge. Guests sharing the hall adjust among themselves.
